helpful: Provisioned petition and BIO text with the QP cut out — the BIO's vehicle and no-split sections were the main drivers of the downward adjustment.
The sal-v4 per-Term band table with bracketed reached rates gave a directly usable anchor.
gaps: No way to look up prior SCOTUS cert petitions by subject or party through the corpus tooling (query has no caption/keyword filter), and RECAP docket search returns nothing for SCOTUS dockets, so priors like earlier Madoff safe-harbor petitions or the Tribune CVSG history could not be checked against a source.
The lower-court opinion was not provisioned and the citation lookup found no text; a provisioned decision-below text would help on error-correction-shaped petitions.
Corpus citation column is sparse (200 of ~590k scotus rows), so --citation lookups of well-known priors mostly fail.
notes: Petition text was truncated at 345 pages but the truncation fell in the appendix; the argument was complete.
